title: Static trace of the first-line-indent report counter
scope: Read-only pseudocode/call-graph review plus bounded disassembly of every function.tsv entry marked decompiled. No target execution.

report_gate.message: Отступ первой строки в абзаце должен быть 1,25 см. (при выравнивании строк а абзаце по центру - 0 см.):

input_property_path.observed_static_behavior: Reads w:firstLine and w:hanging and stores the scaled values to param_2+0x1c; the hanging value is negated.
input_property_path.caller: FUN_0040e9a8 invokes FUN_0040b198 for w:ind at pseudocode lines 6795-6800.
input_property_path.limit: This proves a parsed paragraph property field, not a write to the report counter at parser+0x29c.

generic_counter_helper.behavior: Addresses a report counter through param_1 + param_2*4 + 0x158; increments it by one when param_4 is nonzero, otherwise by text length.
generic_counter_helper.relevant_known_producer: FUN_00437374 calls the helper for indices resolved from offsets +0x290, +0x294, +0x298 (lines 28009, 28021, 28034); no +0x29c / index 0x51 branch appears in that function.

pdf_path_review.main_to_pdf: calls.tsv lists FUN_0047a528 -> FUN_0046ba90; FUN_0046ba90 -> FUN_004645bc.
pdf_path_review.candidate_disposition: The visible local_2a8+0x29c..+0x2a8 uses at lines 53475-53509 are passed to a four-float formatted parser and then released; the surrounding block handles page metadata including MediaBox. This is not evidence that report counter +0x29c is written.
pdf_path_review.literal_offset_check: Across 10,191 functions.tsv entries marked decompiled, full-entry x86 disassembly found zero memory operands with displacement 0x668. This bounds the exported/disassembled function set; it does not rule out an indirect alias or code outside that set.

typed_pointer_check.search: Within the decompiled function set, +0xa7 memory-displacement hits were limited to byte-flag access at 006138a0 and 00613cd0; neither is in the paragraph/report call chain. The focused FUN_00437374 producer references typed offsets +0xa4/+0xa5/+0xa6 only.

common_offset_check.result: Many unrelated structures use +0x144. In FUN_00438304 (pseudocode lines 28244-28633), the +0x144 field participates in geometry/layout calculations on local_78; no connection to the report counter is shown.
common_offset_check.limit: Offset equality alone is not a type or data-flow link.

threshold_role_guard_and_chain.known_report_chain: parser counter +0x29c -> main local_5e0[0x51] > 0 at 0047ee16 -> report emit at 0047ee23
threshold_role_guard_and_chain.missing_link: No producer connecting the parsed +0x1c value to counter +0x29c was identified in this static pass.

search_boundary: No scan of undocumented/undecoded code outside functions.tsv status=decompiled was performed.
No indirect alias analysis across all pointer flows was performed.
The first-line producer threshold, role guard and caller chain remain unresolved; no inference is made from absence of direct offsets.
